div.div: Nothing here is faster. The same bytes arrive over the same connection — they just stopped waiting for each other.

div.div: Waterfalls are about DEPENDENCY, not bandwidth. Before optimising a single byte, ask what the browser could not know it needed yet — that question finds more milliseconds than compression ever will.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
